# Operational Documentation

- Keep README files and project documentation short and operational: only what developers need to install, run, configure, test, build, and understand the system.
- Prefer concise commands, short explanations, and direct references. Avoid marketing, long narratives, historical timelines, and architecture essays.
- Update documentation when the actual developer workflow changes while keeping it compact.
